project_name: Airtel SCM Issue Intelligence & Workflow Management Portal
rationale: Enterprise internal tool prioritizing data density, clarity, and authority. Aligns with Airtel's brand using stark white backgrounds and strong red accents for primary actions and highlights.

layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-4, p-6 for inner containers, p-8 for main sections). Use dense spacing (gap-4) for data-heavy sections.
layout.page_structure: Left Sidebar (Navigation) + Top Header (User, Role Switcher, Notifications, Search) + Main Content Area
layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column grid for complex widgets. Heavy use of bento-box style cards with sharp 4px or 8px border-radius.
layout.cards: Subtle border (border-gray-200), minimal shadow (shadow-sm), flat white background. No heavy gradients or glassmorphism in the main data area.

components_strategy.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary buttons use Airtel Red. Secondary buttons use white background with gray borders. Add active translation (-translate-y-0.5) on hover.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn Table. Dense rows. Use badges for Status, Priority, SLA. Sticky headers for long lists. Zebra striping or subtle hover row backgrounds.
components_strategy.forms: Multi-step wizards for Issue Submission. Clear step indicators. Use Shadcn inputs, selects, and textareas. Left-aligned labels for readability.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts. Use Airtel Red for primary metrics, combined with cool greys or status colors (green/yellow/red) for varied data points.
components_strategy.modals: Shadcn Dialog. Use for 'Similar Issue Popup', Validation screens, and quick edits. Include backdrop blur.
components_strategy.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or small rectangles. Distinct background/text contrast for P0-P3 and SLA states.

screens.name: Login Page
screens.layout: Split screen or centered card over premium abstract background.
screens.key_elements: Mock Role Selector (Dropdown or radio cards), Mock Login Button.
screens.features: Select between Submitter, COE Admin, POC Owner, Leadership, System Admin.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.key_elements: Role-specific greeting, high-level summary widgets (My Tickets, Pending Actions), Quick Action buttons (New Issue).

screens.name: Issue Submission
screens.key_elements: Multi-step form wizard (Step 1: Basic Info, Step 2: Impact/Frequency, Step 3: Details/Attachments). Progress bar at the top.

screens.name: Similar Issue Popup
screens.key_elements: Triggered during Step 1. Shows 2-3 matching tickets. Buttons: 'This is my issue (Link)' or 'Continue creating new'.

screens.name: Ticket Details
screens.layout: 2-column layout (Main Content 8 cols, Meta Sidebar 4 cols)
screens.key_elements: Header with Ticket ID & Status. Main: Description, Comments, Audit Trail. Sidebar: SLA, Priority, Assignee, Impact Score, Linked BRD.

screens.name: COE Workbench
screens.key_elements: Triage Queue (Table), Priority Override dropdowns, Assignment selections, SLA countdowns in rows.

screens.name: POC Task View
screens.key_elements: Columns: To Do, In Progress, Review, Completed. Drag-and-drop or status change dropdowns on cards.

screens.name: BRD Editor
screens.key_elements: Rich text area, Version history sidebar, 'Approve' / 'Request Changes' action buttons.

screens.name: SLA Monitor
screens.key_elements: Countdown timers (bold typography). Red/Yellow/Green alerting chips. Filter by breached vs at-risk.

screens.name: Validation Screen
screens.key_elements: Resolution summary, 'Accept Resolution' (Primary) vs 'Reject & Reopen' (Secondary/Destructive) buttons.

screens.name: Leadership Dashboard
screens.key_elements: KPI Cards (Total Savings, Tickets Closed, SLA %). Recharts (Bar chart: Volume by category, Line chart: Resolution time trends).

screens.name: Admin Console
screens.key_elements: Tabs: Taxonomy (Categories/Subcats), Workflows, Users, Roles. Data tables with edit/delete actions.

screens.name: Notification Center
screens.key_elements: Unread / Read filters. Timestamp. Click to navigate to ticket.

screens.name: Reports
screens.key_elements: Multi-select filters (Date, Status, Category). Export to CSV/PDF button. Paginated table.

login_background.description: Abstract, minimal, premium corporate background featuring subtle waves of Airtel red and pure white, clean enterprise aesthetic.
login_background.usage: Use as a full-cover background image on the login page (Screen 1).

data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, dialog triggers) MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='submit-issue-btn').
